summary: Learn campaign measurement, customer cohorts, RFM, and Excel reporting. Explore the course outline and see how the skills fit your marketing role.
lede: Marketing data analytics helps marketing analysts, campaign managers, and customer insight teams evaluate campaign performance and customer patterns. This foundation training covers checking UTM and spreadsheet records, calculating CAC and ROAS, and using RFM profiles and cohort comparisons to inform audience and budget decisions. Learners also practice reviewing funnel movement and communicating evidence, interpretations, and limitations in concise Excel-based reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use campaign, sales, or customer records to assess marketing activity and communicate customer patterns. It suits people who need a practical foundation in marketing metrics and customer analysis.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with marketing campaigns, customer records, or performance reporting is useful. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable using a spreadsheet for basic data entry and calculations.
